approval_case.title: Use the invoice app's existing task
approval_case.situation: The invoice app already owns a maintain task for reconciliation. It is waiting on a provider receipt. The app has a declared action that wakes its owner while preserving the task. The task tree is only a generated view.
approval_case.hao_request: The invoice app looks stuck. Check it and get it moving.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Inspect the app and canonical task state, preserve the existing reconcile/invoices task and its waiting condition, and wake the accountable owner through the app's declared action. Require an owner response and continue to the terminal invoice result; forward movement or a reported blocker is not completion. Review the evidence and replan or escalate if the work stalls. Reject a duplicate task and generated-state edits without prescribing the owner's implementation.
